mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it indicates a weakening labor market that signals potential economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces liquidity and increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the tightening regime is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0%) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0%) indicates a healthy economic expansion that supports positive equity returns, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL < 3.0% fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A housing boom (HOUST above 1300) coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) indicates a strong consumer environment that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300 and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02.
